cands.name: Richard Gentry
cands.bio: Republican incumbent, 75. Attorney and former lobbyist; previously Florida's Public Counsel. Born in Daytona Beach; UM B.A. and J.D. HD 27 representative since Nov 2024.
cands.local_ties: Born in Daytona Beach (Wikipedia); lives in Lake County (Wikipedia); Florida Politics calls him an Astor Republican.

record.text: Former head of the Office of Public Counsel for the Public Service Commission; the Tampa Bay Times reported earlier work as a lobbyist for developers, sugar producers, the parimutuel industry and a utility-backed nonprofit.
Voted to place Amendment 3 on the ballot, for SB 484 (data centers and utility rates) and for HB 991 (proof of citizenship for voter registration).

endorsements.text: Volusia Sheriff Mike Chitwood, Lake Sheriff Peyton Grinnell and Marion Sheriff Billy Woods endorsed him in 2024.

cands.gaps: Current donors not found. Owner-source check was limited: the alexjoneslive.com site search was run for this name and returned no results. stewpeters.com, rumble.com and infowars.com searches were blocked (HTTP 403) and the shared web-search quota was exhausted, so those were NOT checked.

votes.what: Joint resolution putting Amendment 3 (Save Our Homes property-tax changes: higher homestead exemption, lower assessment-increase limits) on the Nov 2026 ballot.
The 2025-26 General Appropriations Act (state budget), final vote.
Immigration enforcement bill from the 2025 special session: state cooperation with federal immigration enforcement.
Post-hurricane emergency management bill that also limits local governments' ability to adopt stricter development rules after storms.
